translations.web: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
translations.bsb: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
translations.asv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.
